title: Workflow builder và complete node model
scope_items: Database Migration 00036: Created workflows (§12.2), workflow_runs (§12.3), and workflow_run_steps (§12.3A) tables with workspace composite tenant keys, strict tenant RLS isolation (ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), check constraints, and role grants.

Target 1 (Cycle / unbounded graph rejected): DFS 3-color cycle detection algorithm extracts and rejects back-edges (self-loops, 2-node cycles, 3-node cycles, complex branching loops); unbounded graph limit <= 100 nodes enforced; reachability from root trigger and path termination to terminal nodes validated; condition branches strictly validated; declarative transforms enforced (no eval); security audit rejects credentials and raw SQL.

Target 2 (Every node type round trip): Full support for all 10 canonical node types (trigger, condition, transform, action, approval, wait, fallback, diagnostics, handoff, terminal) and 4 trigger types (event, schedule, manual, webhook) across Go domain models, database schema, protobuf wire definitions, SvelteKit web canvas, and Flutter mobile views.

Target 3 (No embedding license assumed): Owned workflow builder and runtime engine is the first-class default (RequiresLicense=false, IsEntitled=true); Activepieces adapter operates as optional secondary plugin and fails closed when unentitled (RequiresLicense=true, IsEntitled=false); zero commercial license key assumed.

Target 4 (Versioning & Portable Export/Import): Monotonic integer versioning with optimistic concurrency conflict detection (ErrVersionMismatch); §27.4 portable export/import round-trip with schema versioning, tenant license notices, and UUID regeneration.
Target 5 (RBAC and Transport Security): Complete 21-RPC WorkflowService implementation with rpc_permission_bindings.csv enforcement, tenant boundary validation, and role authorization.
verified_sub_slices: Target 1 Verified: Go unit test suite (workflow_test.go), Vitest web test suite (workflow.test.ts), and Flutter test suite (workflow_builder_test.dart) confirm cycle rejection, unbounded graph rejection, unreachable node rejection, and security violation detection.

Target 2 Verified: TestEveryNodeType_RoundTripAndSimulation (Go -race) confirms 10-node serialization, storage, retrieval, and dry-run execution with positive estimated credit calculation; TypeScript and Dart round trips verify wire parity.
Target 3 Verified: TestAdapterEntitlement_ZeroLicenseAssumed (Go -race) confirms OwnedWorkflowEngine entitlement and ActivepiecesAdapter fail-closed behavior.
Target 4 Verified: TestVersioningAndOptimisticConcurrency, TestPortableExportImport_RoundTrip, and TestCloneWorkflow pass with optimistic version bump and conflict rejection.
Target 5 Verified: TestRBACPermissionChecks and TestConnectRPCHandler confirm 21 ConnectRPC operations and denial for unauthorized viewer roles.
Concurrency Verified: TestConcurrentWorkflowOperations executes 50 concurrent workflow operations across 10 workers with go test -race (0 data races detected).

Toolchain Verified: check_d0.sh PASS (163 SQL blocks valid), check_proto.sh PASS (Go/TS/Dart 4-target verify and race tests clean), svelte-check PASS (0 errors, 0 warnings), vitest PASS (7 web tests passing), svelte build PASS (SSR and static bundles compiled), flutter analyze PASS (0 issues), flutter test PASS (5 mobile tests passing).

external_gates.description: Activepieces Enterprise requires external commercial licensing. Creativanta implements an owned native canvas and execution engine as first-class baseline per architecture spec, eliminating external license dependency.
